templates.name: Blank app
templates.description: A fresh Next.js app with TypeScript and Tailwind, wired to your database, auth and storage.

templates.name: Waitlist
templates.description: A launch page that collects emails, confirms them by mail, and shows you the list. For a business that is not open yet.

templates.name: Link in bio
templates.description: One page holding every link you post, with per-link click tracking and a shop section that appears once you have something to sell.

templates.name: Bookings
templates.description: Your services, your opening hours, and a page customers book a real time slot on. Confirms by email, both ways.

templates.name: Paid community
templates.description: A members-only feed behind a subscription. The paywall is enforced on the server, not just hidden in the page.

templates.name: Subscription app
templates.description: A marketing page, a paywalled app behind it, and billing your customers manage themselves. Sign in, subscribe, cancel, all wired.

templates.name: Arcade game
templates.description: A one-button browser game with a global leaderboard, ending on your call to action. Something worth sharing that sends people somewhere.

templates.name: Directory
templates.description: A searchable list anyone can submit to and only you approve. Rendered on the server so the listings can be found in search.

templates.name: Digital store
templates.description: Sell files. Tax handled for you, delivery gated on the real payment, and a library the buyer can come back to.
